keys.goldHint: Golden! Land it GREAT to fix
keys.failSub: You stacked {c} of {g}. Shake it off and try again!
keys.allDoneSub: You stacked all the way to the stars · {s} points. More pictures coming soon.
keys.bossCap: Land Great or Perfect to fire a star at the boss. After each attack it gets dizzy for a moment: hits then count double! It fights in 3 phases.
keys.hzc_thief: He swoops in to steal the top Sharliz. Tap him to shoo him away!
keys.hzc_bomb: Tap the bomb to defuse it, or drop it off the side. If it lands on the tower: BOOM!
keys.hzc_wind: When the windsock goes wild, a big gust is coming. Aim into the wind. A Perfect landing anchors the tower.
keys.hzc_balloon: It floats! Land another Sharliz on top before the bubble lifts it away.
keys.hzc_ice: Slippery! Only a Great or Perfect landing will stick.
keys.hzc_fog: Tap the octopus before it squirts ink all over your tower.
keys.hzc_quake: The ground rumbles and the tower shakes. A Perfect landing steadies it.
keys.hzc_size: Giants are heavy but easy to land. Tinies are light but need a precise aim.
keys.reachHint: Build {n} more floors to hit the boss
keys.gateSub: Collect {n} stars in this world to face the boss (you have {h}).
keys.giftLaser: A free laser guide for this try!
keys.coach1: Tap when the Sharliz is right above the tower
keys.coach3: The dotted line shows where you will land, wind included
keys.md_endless: Build as high as you can, through all the worlds
keys.dailyAgain: Done again! The reward is once a day.
keys.dailyLose: You reached {n} of 20 floors. Try again!
keys.photoHint: Press and hold the picture to save it. Tap to close.
keys.wdHint: Tap to try on · drag to spin
keys.dealHead: Today only · 40% off · new deals in {h}h
keys.tipDice: Tap for a random look from your stuff
keys.tipDone: 3 stars = DONE! Grey pins are finished
keys.tipFog: Clear the world below to lift the fog
keys.fogHint: Beat level {n} to clear the fog
keys.bd_laser: Shows exactly where you will land (wind included) for 18 seconds.
keys.bd_shield: Blocks the next hazard: crow, bomb, ink, quake, gust…
keys.bd_revive: Lost all hearts? Jump back in with 2 hearts.
keys.testMode: Test mode — nothing is charged. Real payments switch on when the game ships to the app stores.
keys.pk_ghost: Saves your first lost heart each level
keys.hint_rare: Catch a rare Sharliz on the rope
keys.hint_buddy: Style → Buddy, or hatch an egg
keys.dlSub: Come back every day — day 7 is a big chest!
keys.hp_propeller: Falls slowly — more time to correct
keys.hm_chef: Fewer coins for clearing a level
keys.hm_tophat: Needs 7 PERFECTs in a row for frenzy
keys.storeOff: The store is not available right now
keys.trResetQ: Tap again to erase the report
keys.trCols: Level: tries / wins / losses / quit · time · best floor · boosters
keys.trHelp: Send this to the developer (nothing personal is included).
keys.hzc_bats: Bats swoop through and bump the swinging Sharliz off its rhythm. Tap a bat to scare it away.
keys.hzc_blackout: The street lights go out! Land a PERFECT to bring the power back.
keys.hzc_scorpion: A scorpion climbs the tower. If it reaches the top it stings a Sharliz off. Tap it to flick it away.
keys.hzc_jelly: This one is bouncy: if the landing is not perfect it bounces further off-center.
keys.hzc_icicle: An icicle grows above the tower and drops on the top. Tap it to shatter it first.
keys.hzc_jellyfish: Jellyfish float up. Drop a Sharliz through one and it gets zapped sideways. Tap them to pop them.
keys.hzc_lava: Lava rises from below. Keep building faster than it climbs — perfect landings cool it down.
keys.hzc_portal: Portals on both sides: the swinging Sharliz goes in one side and comes out the other.
keys.hzc_tornado: A tornado pulls everything to one side. A PERFECT landing anchors the tower.
keys.hzc_newspaper: The storm slaps a newspaper over your view. Tap to tear it off.
keys.hzc_dunes: The sand slides the whole tower slowly left and right. Aim for where it will be!
keys.hzc_hail: Candy hail knocks the top Sharliz a little off-center. A PERFECT landing stops it.
keys.hzc_freeze: The swinging Sharliz freezes for a moment — then swings faster when it thaws.
keys.hzc_waves: Waves rock the tower back and forth. Time your drop with the swell.
keys.hzc_meteor: A meteor targets the swing path. Drop before it hits — or tap the meteor to smash it.
keys.hzc_gravity: Gravity drops: Sharliz fall slowly and the wind pushes them longer.
keys.hzc_lightning: A storm cloud charges over the tower and strikes the top. Tap the cloud to break it up.
keys.hzc_monkey: A monkey swings in on a vine to snatch the swinging Sharliz. Tap it to scare it off.
keys.hzc_ghost: A ghost makes the swinging Sharliz invisible for a while. Tap the ghost to banish it.
keys.hzc_cloud: Drop a Sharliz into a cloud and it floats down slowly, drifting with the cloud.
keys.hzc_egg: An egg lands on top of the tower. Tap it before it hatches — the baby dino stomps!
keys.hzc_conveyor: The top Sharliz rides a conveyor and slides after it lands. Catch it fast!
keys.hzc_mirror: Crystal magic flips the whole world left to right for a few seconds.
keys.s2_cap: It is dark! You only see what the tower lantern and the swinging Sharliz light up. Tap fireflies for extra light.
keys.s3_cap: Rain makes every landing slippery: anything less than PERFECT slides a little. Watch out for lightning!
keys.s4_cap: Six brand new worlds, each with its own surprise. Good luck!
keys.csTry: Tap an item to try it on
keys.arcNote: 3 coin plays per game every day
keys.arcFree: No tickets left today: play for the high score!
keys.arcZero: No points this time, so your coin play was not used
keys.arcHowRain: Drag your Sharliz left and right
keys.arcHowMem: Flip two cards to find a pair
keys.arcHowWhack: Tap the monsters, never a Sharliz
keys.evDone: All stages done! Replay for more candy
keys.evExcl: Exclusive items for a limited time!
keys.trInvite: Come play the Sharliz weekly tournament with me! 🏆
keys.twd_wind: The wind pushes twice as hard
keys.trShare: I built {n} floors in the Sharliz weekly tournament! Can you beat me? 🏆
keys.trHow: 3 hearts · as high as you can
keys.psWhy: Unlock every gold reward + 3 exclusive items
keys.lvSub: Great job! You reached a new level!
keys.nestEmpty: No egg yet — win mid-world levels and bosses to find eggs
keys.hatchDupSub: You already have {b} — it turned into cookies
keys.sbHow: Packs come from wins, bosses, the daily gift, weekly missions, level-ups, the tournament, the Pass and events
keys.sbGoldSub: A holo sticker inside for sure!
keys.sbHowG: Golden packs: the gold chest in the bonus stage, a tournament gold medal and day 7 of the daily gift
keys.sbPackSub: Open it in the sticker album
keys.bgS1: {b} stays by your side in every level and in the lobby.
keys.bgS2: The power works only while your buddy is with you. Every buddy has a different power!
keys.bgS3: Tap “{a}” at the bottom, then the “{b}” slot, and pick a buddy.
keys.bgS4a: Wins hatch the eggs in your nest. New buddies come out!
keys.bgS4b: Cookies grow your buddy up to 3 stars. Every star gives more coins.
keys.hzx_bats: Bats bump your Sharliz off its swing
keys.hzo_bats: Tap the bats to scare them away!
keys.hzx_thief: A crow swoops in and steals your top Sharliz
keys.hzo_thief: Tap the crow to shoo it away!
keys.hzx_bomb: If the bomb lands on your tower: BOOM, floors fly off
keys.hzo_bomb: Tap the bomb to defuse it!
keys.hzx_wind: A big gust blows the falling Sharliz off the tower
keys.hzo_wind: Drop it a little into the wind so the gust carries it onto the tower!
keys.hzx_balloon: The bubble grows and lifts the top Sharliz away
keys.hzo_balloon: Quick! Land another Sharliz on it to pop the bubble!
keys.hzx_ice: Ice Sharliz slides off if it lands off the middle
keys.hzo_ice: Tap when it's right above the middle!
keys.hzx_fog: The octopus squirts ink all over your tower
keys.hzo_fog: Tap the octopus before it squirts!
keys.hzx_quake: The quake shakes the top Sharliz off your tower
keys.hzo_quake: Land a Perfect to stop the shaking!
keys.hzx_size: Tiny Sharliz fall off unless they land in the middle
keys.hzo_size: Aim tiny ones right at the middle. Giants land easily!
keys.hzx_lava: Lava rises up the tower. If it reaches the top, you lose a heart
keys.hzo_lava: Land PERFECT to cool it down!
keys.hzx_portal: Your Sharliz goes into one portal and pops out of the other
keys.hzo_portal: Wait until it is above the tower, then tap!
keys.hzx_tornado: The tornado blows a falling Sharliz to one side
keys.hzo_tornado: Drop early, into the wind. A PERFECT landing stops it!
keys.hzx_newspaper: A newspaper sticks to the screen and hides the tower
keys.hzo_newspaper: Tap the newspaper to tear it off!
keys.hzx_dunes: The sand slowly slides the whole tower sideways
keys.hzo_dunes: Aim where the tower will be, not where it was!
keys.hzx_hail: Candy hail knocks the top Sharliz off-centre
keys.hzo_hail: Land PERFECT on it to stop the hail!
keys.hzx_blackout: Lights out! A landing that is not perfect keeps it dark.
keys.hzo_blackout: Wait until it is right above the tower, then tap for a PERFECT.
keys.hzx_scorpion: If the scorpion reaches the top, it stings a Sharliz off.
keys.hzo_scorpion: Tap the scorpion to flick it away.
keys.hzx_jelly: Not in the middle? The jelly bounces further out and falls.
keys.hzo_jelly: Drop it right in the middle for a PERFECT.
keys.hzx_icicle: The icicle falls and knocks the top Sharliz off.
keys.hzo_icicle: Tap the icicle to shatter it before it falls.
keys.hzx_jellyfish: Drop through a jellyfish and ZAP, it flies sideways.
keys.hzo_jellyfish: Tap the jellyfish to pop them, then drop.
keys.hzx_freeze: Your Sharliz freezes, then swings extra fast
keys.hzo_freeze: Wait for the ice to melt, then drop over the tower!
keys.hzx_waves: Waves push the whole tower left and right
keys.hzo_waves: Drop where the tower is going, not where it is!
keys.hzx_meteor: A meteor hits the swing and knocks your Sharliz off
keys.hzo_meteor: Tap the meteor to smash it!
keys.hzx_gravity: Sharliz fall slowly, so the wind blows them far
keys.hzo_gravity: Let go early, on the wind's side, so it drifts onto the tower!
keys.hzx_monkey: A monkey swings in and grabs your Sharliz
keys.hzo_monkey: Tap the monkey to scare it away!
keys.hzx_ghost: A ghost makes your Sharliz invisible
keys.hzo_ghost: Tap the ghost before it gets there!
keys.hzx_cloud: A Sharliz dropped into a cloud floats away with it
keys.hzo_cloud: Wait for the cloud to pass, then drop!
keys.hzx_egg: The egg hatches and the baby dino stomps the top Sharliz off
keys.hzo_egg: Tap the egg before it hatches!
keys.hzx_conveyor: The belt slides the top Sharliz to the edge
keys.hzo_conveyor: Drop the next one fast to stop it!
keys.hzx_mirror: Magic flips the world left and right
keys.hzo_mirror: Look again, then drop when it's over the tower!
keys.ssNoDup: No doubles yet. Open packs to get some!
keys.ssHow: Sell doubles → stars → buy what you want!

keys.stKeep: Keep playing to see what happens next

pairs: A big hug, then a big nap.
A big, sleepy group hug on a cloud bed.
A crow snatches the map! The chase is on across the field.
A fish! A tiny one, but a fish!
A gentle long-neck dinosaur gives them a ride.
A golden staircase rises through the clouds.
A grand feast up in the clouds. Yum!
A little chick hops over and chirps: “You can do it!”
A lollipop bridge leads on to the snowy mountains.
A mirage? No, a real oasis! Splash!
A new heart! I feel better.
A penguin buddy waddles over to help.
A perfect stack opens the old temple door.
A pumpkin lantern party fills the castle hall.
A sandstorm! They stack into a wall to protect the smallest one.
A shooting star lands on the farm. A little teal Sharliz wakes up, amazed.
A shooting star that grants one wish.
A snowball battle in the village. Splat!
A stormy night. Everyone squeezes under one umbrella.
A throne of coins, fit for a legend.
A toy factory full of conveyor belts and spinning gears.
A volcano island glows red in the night.
A warm tropical sea at last: a lighthouse and a treasure map!
A whole galaxy of golden stars.
A wild mine cart ride into a crystal cave!
A wish for every friend floats up in a bubble.
All the friends and buddies stack together: the tallest tower ever!
Am I an egg? Kind of, yes.
Among the sunflowers, they practise perfect landings again and again.
Are we there yet? Are we there yet?
At night the city sparkles, and the Ferris wheel glows.
BOOM BOOM! Gorilla King's drums shake the trees.
Balances the ball all day long.
Blast off! Their faces squish from the speed.
Blow! Blow! Okay, one more blow...
Blub! A slime buddy oozes out of a fountain and joins the gang.
Boing! Bouncing on fluffy cloud pillows.
Bow down. Or at least wobble.
Brrr! Look, my breath is a cloud!
Built the first tower. And the pyramids.
Buried up to the middle. Worth it!
By the campfire, they tell the little ones the whole story.
Close your eyes and wish big.
Counting to ten... one... two... GRRR!
Crack! The frozen sea breaks, and they float away on an ice floe.
Crash! The rocket lands in the jungle treetops.
Don't drop one... don't drop one...
Don't look down. Don't look down.
Don't talk to me. Okay, a little.
Down a rainbow slide between floating islands.
Down a rainbow, all the way back to the farm!
Drops the beat, never the tower.
Eight golden tentacles. One golden grin.
Eight wiggly friends on my head.
Every buddy gets its own little house in the garden.
Every buddy in gold, all in one parade.
Every colour has its own sound.
Fireworks burst over the Sky Castle.
First snow! The warm-coloured Sharliz shiver: brrr!
Five in a row! On fire!
Fixed it! Wait... what was it?
Float like a jelly, sting like a bee.
Float up and carry my wish.
Floating in space, upside down and giggling.
Fog rolls in. A haunted castle waits on the hill...
For the greatest collector of all.
Found the treasure. Is the treasure.
Friendly bats fly them over the castle wall.
Friendly ghosts want to play hide and seek!
Ghost King shouts BOO! Everyone jumps out of their skin.
Giant dino eggs! One cracks... hello, baby dino buddy!
Give me an S! Give me an H!
Glowing crystals reflect every happy face.
Goodbye, farm! The old windmill waves in the wind.
Got it, got it, NEED it!
Grumpy thunder clouds rumble. Storm chase!
Guardian of the pearl of the deep.
Gulp! Wait, was that a fly?
Happy tears and a very big cup.
Has a plan. A sneaky plan.
Head spin! The world spins too.
Heh heh heh... I have an idea.
Hello down there! Bye down there!
Hello? Anyone? Is this the tower?
Help! The taco is falling apart!
Ho ho ho! A gift for you!
Hop, hop, careful! Stepping stones over the lava.
I said a SLOW rocket! SLOW!
I see... a VERY tall tower.
I vant to suck... your juice box!
Ice cream on a rooftop as the sun goes down.
In Rat King's sewer, scary eyes glow in the dark...
In the morning she tells her friends. They laugh: “A tower to the sky?”
Inside: a hall of stickers from every adventure so far.
Is it safe to come out yet?
It's bigger than me. I can do this!
It's exactly what I wished for!
Just one tiny drop. Big mistake.
KA-BOOM! Who turned the sky up?
Kind words are the best medicine.
Kraken Inky rises from the waves!
Landing on the moon: first bouncy hops in the dust.
Lands so hard the ground turns gold.
Look! A new shooting star crosses the sky...
Lost in a busy crossing. Honk! Honk! Which way now?
Made it to the top! Flag time!
Made you a heart. Be my friend?
Magma Rex roars. The dragon buddy roars right back!
Make a wish on every bubble.
Mega Robot wakes up. Its eyes glow red...
Mixed up on the assembly line, they come out with robot parts!
My house, my sofa, my rules!
My nose glows! Need a light?
Nailed the landing. Cracked the floor.
Night camp under the pyramids, with stories by the fire.
No tower falls on this knight's watch.
No up, no down, just stars.
Nobody is safe in the snow village.
Nod to the beat. Nod. Nod.
Northern lights dance over an igloo. Everyone goes quiet: wow.
Now you see me... now you half do.
On the volcano rim, they build a rocket out of junk.
One big photo: friends, buddies, even the bosses!
One clever stack, and they hop right over the pigeons!
One golden hop on a golden moon.
One high note. One cracked glass.
One spell, a thousand golden stars.
Oops! They fall through a cloud hole into a dino valley.
Oui oui! A baguette for two?
Over the castle and far away.
Over the dunes, a pink and sparkly candy land appears!
Pigeon Boomer blocks the bridge. The friends tremble.
Please go in, please go in...
Queen Gumdrop's castle looms, guarded by gingerbread soldiers.
Rides every wave of the level.
Rides the sky on wings of gold.
Rises from the flames, brighter than ever.
Rule number one: don't hug a cactus.
Ruler of the tallest tower of all.
Sand, sand and more sand. Everyone is thirsty and droopy.
Shake it, and the farm sparkles.
Shh! The best part is coming!
Shh... just me and the snow.
Shh... the moon makes a great pillow.
Silent as moonlight. Twice as shiny.
Small, sweet and changing the world!
Softest bed in the whole sky.
Some cake went in. Most went on.
Something legendary is about to hatch...
Spins until the ice gets dizzy.
Stack high enough and you reach the moon.
Steer left! No, the OTHER left!
Stretchy music for a stretchy friend.
Stuck in a caramel trap! The bee buddy buzzes in and frees them.
Sunset over a volcano, with pterodactyls soaring above.
Tap it! TAP IT! Tap it now!
Ten Sharliz high, all the way to the sun.
The Crystal Golem blocks the very last tunnel.
The Golem smiles and steps aside. The way is open!
The biggest cup. The biggest heart.
The castle at the top of every tower.
The classic. Every collection starts here.
The coziest umbrella in the forest.
The crowd sees gold. The crowd goes wild.
The cyborg buddy powers up: beep beep, ready!
The farm animals cheer: they're back!
The fastest way down a rainbow.
The final guardian, gleaming in gold.
The first skyscrapers! Everyone stares with mouths wide open.
The gates of the Sky Castle shimmer. They made it!
The little ones start their own wobbly tower.
The map says... left? Or up?
The monkey buddy shows them a secret path.
The old torn map now hangs on the barn wall.
The only tower you're allowed to eat.
The perfect landing, forever in gold.
The room is spinning. Or is it me?
The shooting star from the start is here: the Star Keeper!
The shy Sharliz wishes for courage... and starts to glow.
The star whispers: “Build a tower tall enough to reach the Sky Castle.”
The tallest sandcastle on the beach!
The tiny one slips through a vent and saves the day!
The tower at sunrise. A new adventure is already waiting...
The unicorn buddy gallops across the sky!
The view from up here is the best.
Their first tower in the barnyard is three Sharliz high. It falls. Giggles!
Their tallest tower yet grows like a beanstalk into the clouds.
They bounce on the giant red button. Confetti, not explosions!
They build a tower monument in the field for everyone to see.
They dream of home: the little farm far below.
They escape on a skateboard down the hill, cheering all the way!
They get the map back, a bit torn. A dotted path leads to the city.
They pack a tiny backpack full of snacks. Adventure time!
Toasting marshmallows over a lava stream. So much laughing!
Too much candy! Tummy aches... and lots of laughs.
Top of the pyramid! Now what?
Triceratops stomps by. The friends hide in a fern.
Tweet! No stacking in the hallway!
Two Sharliz, one big squishy hug.
Um... how do I get down?
Under the sea in bubble helmets, with coral and fish all around.
Up, up... and a perfect landing!
Victory parade! Gumdrops rain from the sky.
Vines, parrots and a waterfall slide. Wheee!
Wait... am I a poodle now?
Wait... which one of us is me?
Washed up on a beach, they build a sandcastle tower.
We did it! Hop, hop, hooray!
What cookies? There are no cookies.
Why does SHE get the top spot?
Wibble wobble, jelly on a plate!
Wind in my face, grin on my face!
Worth a million coins. At least.
Wow, you're even taller than me!
Yeti Freezy starts an avalanche, so they ride it on a sled!
You did not see this sticker.
Zorg's UFO zaps one Sharliz... and shrinks her tiny!

pw.swayK: Sand and waves barely move the tower
